text:
yuri: noticed odd snippet in partner webhook payloads: `vault://transit:ct-1a2b3c4d` — not plaintext but definitely a transit ciphertext identifier. tagging sec.

kasia: thanks, yuri. can you paste a minimal redacted sample and which service sent it?

yuri: pasted sample (redacted) to secure incident bundle /secure/incidents/5012345678/sample.txt. source svc=connector-sync namespace=integrations. timestamp ~2026-03-25T08:12Z.

sec-oncall: triage: treat as sensitive. immediate checklist: 1) search logs for `vault://transit:` pattern across last 14d, 2) restrict transit/decrypt on keys referenced, 3) contact partner to confirm no decrypt attempts. who's on rotation?

avault-bot: audit hit: principal=ci-builder used transit/decrypt on key=rekey-ephemeral@v1 at 2026-03-18T02:41:10Z

ana: (ana) I can rotate the wrapping key and rewrap any leaked ciphertexts. need list of ciphertext ids. also recommend moving connector-sync to use envelope encryption with ephemeral keys.

ops: added temporary IAM deny on key ring ephemeral-ring for non-oncall principals (change-id change-20260325-01). also started a grep job: `gsutil cat gs://partner-logs/* | grep -E \"vault://transit:\"` — results will be uploaded.

sec-oncall: running Vault audit export for `transit/*` decrypt ops last 30d: `vault audit search --path transit --op decrypt --since 30d` — will share csv.

yuri: quick note — connector-sync is still using a legacy SA with user-managed key created 2026-03-10. we should rotate that SA keys even if ciphertexts are just identifiers.

kasia: I'll take ownership of connector migration to workload identity. ETA 6h for canary. will coordinate with ana for rewrap.

ana: rewrap plan: create new KMS key `ephemeral-wrap-v3`, run rewrap for each ciphertext id with `gcloud kms rewrap`, then update Vault transit wrapping key alias and restart affected agents. will test decrypt in staging before prod.

avault-bot: audit export: 5 decrypt ops found by internal CI between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-20. no external principals. CSV uploaded to /secure/incidents/5012345678/audit.csv

ops: grep job found 9 occurrences across partner-sink and legacy-bridge. marking legacy-bridge higher priority — it's not on workload identity. created INFRA-4110 to sweep similar connectors.

sec-oncall: containment items: 
- ops: keep deny on key ring until rewrap complete 
- kasia: migrate connector-sync to workload identity (canary first) 
- ana: rewrap leaked ciphertexts and rotate wrapping key version 
- yuri: run org grep for `vault://transit:` and attach samples to incident bundle
Timeline: containment within 2h, full migration/rewrap within 48h. postmortem later.

kasia: starting canary now (10%). will monitor auth errors and latency.

ana: created key ephemeral-wrap-v3 @v1 and rewrapped sample ciphertext `ct-1a2b3c4d` -> success. updated Vault transit alias to ephemeral-wrap-v3@v1 and pushed config.

ops: deny rule remains in place. INFRA-4110 created for org-wide automation to detect `vault://transit` patterns and auto-open tickets.

sec-oncall: audit confirmation: no external decrypts. containment closed. follow-ups: rotation sweep for legacy-bridge SA keys, infra automation rollout, runbook update to classify transit id leakage as high-sev. postmortem scheduled 21:00 UTC.

yuri: thanks all. i'll run the wider scan and post results to the incident bundle. :thumbsup:
